newsitem.title: USA: Forcenergy bids for Alaska offshore lease.
newsitem.headline: Forcenergy bids for Alaska offshore lease.

text.p: Forcenergy Inc on Wednesday offered to buy two tracts of offshore oil and natural gas in Alaska from the U.S. Interior Department's Minerals Management Service (MMS).
Miami-based Forcenergy submitted bids totalling $253,965 for the tracts, which encompass 9,799 acres, or two percent of the total area offered by MMS, the agency said in a statement.
The area offered for lease was much smaller than originally planned after local fishermen, environmental groups and native communities lodged complaints against the sale.
The state of Alaska will receive 27 percent of the revenue generated from the tracts.
